name: External and internal claims group modes
requiresDatabases: Existing AM claims authority PostgreSQL database
requiresEnv: Existing claims authority and Finance Claims V3 configuration

dataIsolation.guard: Group modes are tenant-scoped; raw LINE identities remain encrypted and production group assignments are not stored in this package.

definitionOfDone: Claims administrators can choose external claim-only or internal V3 mode per LINE group
External legacy-form applicants do not require Finance identity onboarding
Exact group, exact applicant, expiry and individual denial checks remain enforced
V3 forms cannot be published to external groups
Platform notification reads work with FORCE RLS without weakening tenant writes
